topic: New customers do not search a business by name, they search the service. What a Google profile needs so you are the answer.

scenes.say: New customers don't know your name.
They type what they need. Plumber near me.
Tell Google your category, hours, photos, reviews and website.

scenes.question: What would a stranger type to find you?

caption:
A new customer has never heard of you. So they don't type your name. They type what they need: "plumber near me", "hair salon open now".

Google can only show you for that search if your profile says what you do. Five things to fill in: the right category, real opening hours, photos of your work, reviews, and a link to your website.

What would a stranger type to find you?
